raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Follow-up to #59857, enabling text-only DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash PCP Prefill with NIXL P/D. Stacked on #59325 for replicated-PCP producer completion.

## Claims

- Allow GPU `NixlConnector` pull producers to use PCP, with PCP=1 on Decode.
- Allow fixed-length DSpark and optional APC with SWA bounded replay.
- Retain PP=DP=DCP=1 and synchronous scheduling. Consumer PCP, push, bidirectional transfer and custom connector paths remain unsupported.

## Validation

### Image

`vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-edad8b03c5285a1c12e7e4f83c1af709b319a01b`

Official linux/amd64 digest: `sha256:d31ecffc8a9613b1f7c6c849a45e01bb9f0ac86a177f7dd802f29b4e51390198`.

### Software

- Overlaid this PR at commit `20a882654abbb8aee6ebef1ba110a76314d8a164` (`vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py`).
- Overlaid the pull-mode completion fix from #59325 at commit `52c8468f7c27a73047460376b5f90fcb13af8695` (`vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/connector.py`).

### vLLM startup

Relevant environment:

```bash
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST=<LOCAL_ROLE_HOST>
export VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5600
export UCX_TLS=all
export UCX_NET_DEVICES=<RDMA_DEVICES>
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=<SOCKET_IFACE>
export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=<SOCKET_IFACE>
```

Prefill (TP2/PCP4):

```bash
vllm serve <MODEL_PATH> \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 18001 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 4 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --moe-backend humming \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \
  --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --swa-bounded-replay \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}' \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}'
```

Decode (TP8/PCP1):

```bash
vllm serve <MODEL_PATH> \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 18002 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --language-model-only \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --all2all-backend allgather_reducescatter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --moe-backend humming \
  --max-model-len 131072 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
  --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --swa-bounded-replay \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}' \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-async-scheduling \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log \
  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_buffer_device":"cuda","kv_load_failure_policy":"fail"}'
```

### GSM8K

EvalScope version: `1.11.1`.

```bash
evalscope eval \
  --eval-type openai_api \
  --api-url http://<ROUTER_HOST>:30000/v1 \
  --api-key EMPTY \
  --model deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --model-id deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --datasets gsm8k \
  --dataset-hub modelscope \
  --dataset-args '{"gsm8k":{"few_shot_num":4}}' \
  --seed 42 \
  --eval-batch-size 64 \
  --generation-config '{"temperature":0.0,"top_p":1.0,"max_tokens":8192,"reasoning_effort":"high","seed":42,"timeout":10000}' \
  --timeout 10000 \
  --work-dir <WORK_DIR> \
  --no-timestamp
```

- Result: `1283 / 1319` correct (`97.2707%`), within the local historical control range of `1279-1286 / 1319`.
- Execution: `1319 / 1319` requests succeeded with `0` API errors; `3` responses reached the 8192-token limit.
- Truncation diagnostic: a separate 65536-token replay recovered correct final answers for 2 of the 3 truncated samples; the primary score was not replaced.
- NIXL: `10,552` successful rank transfers and `53,282,008,576` transferred bytes, with `0` failed transfers, notification failures, or KV expirations.
- Health: `0` preemptions and `0` service restarts.
- Cache-state note: prefix-cache reset endpoints were unavailable because the servers were not launched in dev mode; both roles were idle with zero active KV usage before the run.

## Details

Keep the capability checks in the NVIDIA model and reuse the existing cache-transfer path. Add one focused PCP+NIXL configuration test. The completion fix is inherited from #59325.

AI assistance was used for implementation and tests.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
